dialogues.speaker: Unknown
dialogues.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’m going to be the first to beat the battle
arena.
dialogues.context_comment: テントを出たのでBGMの音量を上げる

dialogues.speaker: Unknown
dialogues.text: [ea][a7][b0] I’m not going anywhere until they open it.
dialogues.context_comment: テントを出たのでBGMの音量を上げる

dialogues.speaker: Unknown
dialogues.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You’re new to the battle arena, huh?
Okay, let me tell you how it works.
dialogues.context_comment: テントを出たのでBGMの音量を上げる

dialogues.speaker: Unknown
dialogues.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Seasoned pros like me have an obligation to
show you newcomers the ropes.
dialogues.context_comment: テントを出たのでBGMの音量を上げる

dialogues.speaker: Unknown
dialogues.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The battle arena is tough. You’re not allowed
to issue detailed orders or use items.
dialogues.context_comment: テントを出たのでBGMの音量を上げる

dialogues.speaker: Unknown
dialogues.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The best way to get started is to have a go at
the Rank E challenge.
dialogues.context_comment: テントを出たのでBGMの音量を上げる

dialogues.speaker: Unknown
dialogues.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Yeah? You completed the Rank E challenge?
You’ve still got a long way to go, though...
dialogues.context_comment: テントを出たのでBGMの音量を上げる

dialogues.speaker: Unknown
dialogues.context_comment: テントを出たのでBGMの音量を上げる

dialogues.speaker: Unknown
dialogues.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But don’t give up. Keep at it and who knows?
You might even catch me...one day.
dialogues.context_comment: テントを出たのでBGMの音量を上げる

dialogues.speaker: Unknown
dialogues.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Rank D, huh?
Not bad, but it’s hardly newsworthy.
dialogues.context_comment: テントを出たのでBGMの音量を上げる

dialogues.speaker: Unknown
dialogues.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Everyone knows that Rank B is the first real
test of a scout’s abilities.
dialogues.context_comment: テントを出たのでBGMの音量を上げる

dialogues.speaker: Unknown
dialogues.text: [ea][a7][b0] Incidentally, I just finished Rank B.
dialogues.context_comment: テントを出たのでBGMの音量を上げる

dialogues.speaker: Unknown
dialogues.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You passed Rank C?
Heh heh. Not bad, kid.
dialogues.context_comment: テントを出たのでBGMの音量を上げる

dialogues.speaker: Unknown
dialogues.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Me?
Oh, right now I’m going for Rank A.
dialogues.context_comment: テントを出たのでBGMの音量を上げる

dialogues.speaker: Unknown
dialogues.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Y’know, it’s good to have someone on my tail.
Keeps me focused.
dialogues.context_comment: テントを出たのでBGMの音量を上げる

dialogues.speaker: Unknown
dialogues.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You cleared Rank B!?
Th-That means we’re level!
dialogues.context_comment: テントを出たのでBGMの音量を上げる

dialogues.speaker: Unknown
dialogues.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But the race isn’t over yet!
Let’s see who can pass Rank A first!
dialogues.context_comment: テントを出たのでBGMの音量を上げる

dialogues.speaker: Unknown
dialogues.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The loser will have to call the other one ‘boss’.
Sound good?
dialogues.context_comment: テントを出たのでBGMの音量を上げる

dialogues.speaker: Unknown
dialogues.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You cleared Rank A!?
I’ve gotta admit it [96] you ARE the boss!
dialogues.context_comment: テントを出たのでBGMの音量を上げる

dialogues.speaker: Unknown
dialogues.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I did everything I could,
but my best wasn’t good enough.
dialogues.context_comment: テントを出たのでBGMの音量を上げる

dialogues.speaker: Unknown
dialogues.text:
[ea][a7][b0] How did you manage, ki[96] um, boss?
I’d kill to do what you just did!
dialogues.context_comment: テントを出たのでBGMの音量を上げる

dialogues.speaker: Unknown
dialogues.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Nicely done, boss!
Rank S is history!
dialogues.context_comment: テントを出たのでBGMの音量を上げる

dialogues.speaker: Unknown
dialogues.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I watched you fight.
It was unbelievable!
dialogues.context_comment: テントを出たのでBGMの音量を上げる

dialogues.speaker: Unknown
dialogues.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You are the boss of bosses, my friend.
There’s no way I could ever beat you!
dialogues.context_comment: テントを出たのでBGMの音量を上げる

dialogues.speaker: Unknown
dialogues.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Awesome, [f5]!
I knew you could do it!
dialogues.context_comment: テントを出たのでBGMの音量を上げる

dialogues.speaker: Unknown
dialogues.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You’re more than just the boss.
You’re out of this world!
dialogues.context_comment: テントを出たのでBGMの音量を上げる

dialogues.speaker: Unknown
dialogues.text: [ea][a7][b0] You’re the Rank X battlemeister himself!
dialogues.context_comment: テントを出たのでBGMの音量を上げる

dialogues.speaker: Unknown
dialogues.text:
[ea][a7][b0] How are things, battlemeister, sir?
You’re looking sharp as always.

[df]What a relief.
If we had lost this...

dialogues.speaker: Dr Snap
dialogues.text:
[df]Ah, [f5].
Did you come to check on me?

dialogues.speaker: Dr Snap
dialogues.text:
[df]Well, don’t you worry, my boy.
I’m quite all right, I assure you.

dialogues.speaker: Dr Snap
dialogues.text:
[df]All the bounders took were my research notes and
a diary.

dialogues.speaker: Dr Snap
dialogues.text:
[df]But I haven’t lost a thing.
It’s all up here, in my head.

dialogues.speaker: Dr Snap
dialogues.text: [df]The important thing is that no one was hurt.

dialogues.speaker: Dr Snap
dialogues.text:
[df]Well, then. Let’s put this unpleasant incident behind
us, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Dr Snap
dialogues.text: [df]The Scout’s Mark is still safe and sound.

dialogues.speaker: Dr Snap
dialogues.text:
[df]So you, young man, can go back to worrying about
your challenge.

dialogues.speaker: Dr Snap
dialogues.text:
[df]I’ve taught you some of my finest tricks.
[f1][fb][fd]
It would be a shame not to see them put into
practice in the finals!

dialogues.speaker: Dr Snap
dialogues.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The award ceremony will take place in the
Commissioner’s office.[f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] He’s waiting for you there now.

dialogues.speaker: Dr Snap
dialogues.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Ahem.
This is the Commissioner’s office.

dialogues.speaker: Dr Snap
dialogues.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The Commissioner is a very busy man,
don’t you know? He’s not to be disturbed.

dialogues.speaker: Kakariin
dialogues.text: [eb][a7][b0] I’m not authorised to allow anyone inside.

dialogues.speaker: Kakariin
dialogues.text: There is no time for that now.

dialogues.speaker: Kakariin
dialogues.text: Take the lift and leave Monster Scout HQ?

dialogues.speaker: Kakariin
dialogues.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You’re here for the challenge, is that right?
Let me just register you...

dialogues.speaker: Kakariin
dialogues.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Okay, [f5]. I’ve registered you as a
participant, so you’re all set.

dialogues.speaker: Kakariin
dialogues.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Let me tell you about the Monster Scout
Challenge.

dialogues.speaker: Kakariin
dialogues.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Your first objective is to collect ten darkonium
crystals.

dialogues.speaker: Kakariin
dialogues.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Darkonium is a rare kind of rock, usually taking
the form of star-shaped crystals.

dialogues.speaker: Kakariin
dialogues.text:
[eb][a7][b0] There are darkonium crystals scattered across
the islands.

dialogues.speaker: Kakariin
dialogues.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Once you collect ten of them, you’re allowed
to proceed to the goal.

dialogues.speaker: Kakariin
dialogues.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The first five scouts who reach the goal
advance to the next round of the challenge.

dialogues.speaker: Kakariin
dialogues.text: [eb][a7][b0] And that’s all you need to know for now.

dialogues.speaker: Kakariin
dialogues.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You can always come here later to remind
yourself of the rules.

[ea][a7][b0] Isn’t it confusing that different monsters use
different weapons?

dialogues.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I used to think that once I became a scout, I
could go out with any girl I wanted.

stability. You know, regular hours, regular pay.

dialogues.speaker: Unknown

dialogues.speaker: Mr Wuffles
dialogues.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I bet you’ve got lots of girlfriends, being in the
finals and all.

dialogues.speaker: Mr Wuffles
dialogues.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I could never be that popular.

dialogues.speaker: Mr Wuffles
dialogues.text:
[ea][a7][b0] [a8]sigh[a9] I wish someone would open a matchmaking
service for scouts...

dialogues.speaker: Mr Wuffles
dialogues.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Mr Wuffles won’t accept any monster less
than Rank A [96] though we’d much prefer Rank S.

dialogues.speaker: Mr Wuffles
dialogues.text: [eb][a7][b0] But the matchmaking centre is hopeless.

dialogues.speaker: Mr Wuffles
dialogues.text:
[eb][a7][b0] We’ve been here FOREVER and they haven’t
found a single suitable partner.

dialogues.speaker: Mr Wuffles
dialogues.text:
[eb][a7][b0] We refuse to compromise.
Mr Wuffles is VERY particular.

dialogues.speaker: Mr Wuffles
dialogues.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Hey, champ. I bet you have all the girlfriends
a guy could want, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Mr Wuffles
dialogues.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Aaah, I’d give anything to be in your shoes.
Anything!

dialogues.speaker: Mr Wuffles
dialogues.text:
[ea][a7][b0] [a8]sigh[a9] I wish someone would open a matchmaking
service for scouts...

dialogues.speaker: Mr Wuffles
dialogues.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You seem to have some interesting monsters with
you.

dialogues.speaker: Mr Wuffles
dialogues.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I wonder if one of them would be a good match
for Mr Wuffles?

dialogues.speaker: Mr Wuffles
dialogues.text:
[eb][a7][b0] But if we did bring them together, I would have
to say bye-bye to Mr Wuffles.

dialogues.speaker: Mr Wuffles
dialogues.text: [eb][a7][b0] ...NO! I couldn’t bear to part with him!

dialogues.speaker: Mr Wuffles
dialogues.text:
[eb][a7][b0] [a8]sigh[a9] I should never have brought him here in
the first place...

dialogues.speaker: Mr Wuffles
dialogues.text: [eb][a7][b0] I couldn’t possibly live without my Mr Wuffles.

dialogues.speaker: Mr Wuffles
dialogues.text: [ea][a7][b0] Yeah, well...actually, we’re going on a date.
